name: Product Video & Variation Image Gallery for WooCommerce
author: WP Easy Soft

sections.description:
Product Video & Variation Image Gallery for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin that lets you add YouTube, HTML5, and embed videos to your WooCommerce product pages. You can also add multiple gallery images to each product variation. Boost customer engagement and increase conversions by showcasing your products with professional video content and variation-specific images.

Perfect for WooCommerce store owners who want to display product demonstration videos, unboxing videos, tutorials, promotional content, or showcase product variations with multiple images directly in their product galleries.

Supported Video Types

  • YouTube Videos – Embed YouTube videos directly with optimized performance
  • HTML5 Videos – Upload and display MP4, WebM, and OGG video files
  • Embed Videos – Support for YouTube, Vimeo, PeerTube, and other embed formats

Video Gallery Features

  • Variable Product Support – Add unique videos to each product variation
  • Thumbnail Gallery – Display video thumbnails in bottom, left, right, or top positions
  • Customizable Thumbnails – Round corners, numbering, navigation arrows, and color options
  • Responsive Design – Works perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

Variation Image Gallery

  • Multiple Images Per Variation – Add unlimited gallery images to each product variation
  • Drag & Drop Ordering – Easily reorder variation images with drag and drop
  • Dynamic Gallery Switching – Gallery automatically updates when customers select a variation
  • Zoom & Lightbox Support – Variation images support hover zoom and PhotoSwipe lightbox
  • Seamless Integration – Works with WooCommerce default gallery and popular themes

Video Player Controls

  • Autoplay & Muted playback options
  • Loop video continuously
  • Playback speed control
  • Fullscreen toggle
  • Volume control
  • Progress bar with remaining time display
  • Big play button for easy interaction
  • Smooth seeking navigation
  • Playsinline for mobile optimization

Theme Compatibility

Fully compatible with popular WooCommerce themes:

  • Astra
  • OceanWP
  • Storefront
  • Kadence
  • Neve
  • Hello Elementor
  • Avada
  • Hestia
  • eStore
  • Sydney
  • And many more…

Why Choose Product Video Gallery?

  • Lightweight & Fast – Uses WooCommerce default slider, no extra JavaScript libraries loaded
  • Easy Setup – Simple configuration with intuitive settings panel
  • SEO Friendly – Optimized video embedding for better search visibility
  • Regular Updates – Actively maintained with WordPress and WooCommerce compatibility

Pro Features

Upgrade to Product Video Gallery Pro for advanced features:

  • Multiple Videos – Add multiple videos per product
  • Video Ordering – Arrange videos in your preferred order
  • Shop Page Video – Display product videos on shop/category pages
  • Shortcode Support – Use [pvg_product_video] with Elementor and other page builders
  • Vimeo Integration – Direct Vimeo video support

How to use Product Video Gallery for WooCommerce plugin – Video Tutorial
sections.installation:
1. Choose to add a new plugin, then click upload
  2. Upload the product-video-gallery-for-wc zip
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Can I add videos to variable products?

Yes! You can add unique videos to each product variation. When customers select a variation, the corresponding video will display in the product gallery.

Can I add multiple images to each variation?

Yes! The plugin includes a Variation Image Gallery feature that lets you add multiple images to each product variation. Simply edit your variable product, expand a variation, and use the “Add Variation Gallery Image” button to upload images. You can drag and drop to reorder them.

What video formats are supported?

The plugin supports YouTube videos, HTML5 videos (MP4, WebM, OGG), and embed videos from platforms like Vimeo and PeerTube.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is optimized for performance and uses the WooCommerce default slider. Videos are loaded efficiently to ensure fast page loading times.

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with most popular WooCommerce themes including Astra, OceanWP, Storefront, Kadence, Elementor themes, Avada, and many more.

Can I customize the video player controls?

Yes! You can enable/disable various player controls including autoplay, loop, fullscreen, volume control, progress bar, playback speed, and more.

Where do video thumbnails appear?

You can position video thumbnails at the bottom, left, right, or top of the main product image. You can also customize thumbnail styling with rounded corners, numbering, and custom navigation colors.

Does the plugin work with page builders?

The Pro version includes a shortcode [pvg_product_video] that works with Elementor and other page builders.

How do I add a video to a product?

Simply edit your WooCommerce product, scroll to the Product Video Gallery section, enter your video URL (YouTube, embed, or upload HTML5), and save. The video will automatically appear in your product gallery.
